The Sewer Dweller aspect can indicate a tendency to dwell on the darker aspects of life, where fears and anxieties reside. However, this placement also holds the potential for profound growth and transformation, as you confront and integrate your shadow self. Your inner world is a complex, multifaceted tapestry, woven from threads of light and darkness. As you navigate this aspect, be prepared for a journey of self-discovery and transformation.
